sections.content: General people words: ember (person), férfi (man), nő (woman), barát (friend). Combine them with adjectives you already know: Ő egy magas férfi (He is a tall man).
sections.title: People words

sections.content: ember is gender-neutral — 'a person,' covering both férfi and nő, the way you'd say 'a person' in English without specifying.
